resources.string: Resolver did not answer (servers that only speak HTTP/2 are not supported). The default lookup is used instead.

Resolves proxy host names and the backup data-centre list through this DNS-over-HTTPS server instead of the system DNS and the built-in Cloudflare lookup. If it does not answer, the default lookup is used. Not used while Tor is on.
If the current proxy cannot connect for 10 seconds, test the other saved proxies and switch to the fastest one that works. Replaces the switching step of the built-in proxy rotation while on.
Disable proxy while a VPN is active
Connect directly through the VPN instead of the saved proxy while one is up. Your proxy stays selected and comes back when the VPN goes down. Tor is never bypassed.
Applies to all accounts. A VPN is active now, so the proxy is bypassed.
